headline: Session done — aerobic carrier hit, clean and on-plan
summary: 70min prescribed, 67.8min logged (4065s moving) at 149bpm average — right in the 140-150bpm Z2 target band, no drift into tempo. Load landed at 66 vs 65 estimated, essentially a dead-on match, and RPE was low (3/10, feel 2). Cadence 82spm, clean flat Bucharest terrain, no pain or ITB signal reported. This was exactly what the plan asked for: a volume carrier with the legs left fresh for Sunday's intensity.
flags: Three days post-Monza HM (29 Sep) ATL is still elevated (51.4) against CTL 48.3, ramp rate +1.4 — normal absorption curve, nothing to react to.
Today's low RPE and tight HR control suggest good recovery from Monza; no reason to adjust Sunday's intensity session.
